description: Synthetic sesslint.repair.writeback parity (emit_vendor_bytes refusals R1-R6, hashlib and canonical record-hash seams).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-writeback-hashlib: Python hashes emitted bytes with hashlib.sha256 for ProjectionSummary; Rust returns hashlib.sha256 is not available and does not construct ProjectionSummary.

GAP-writeback-canonical-record-hash: When source_record_hash is non-empty and the line parses, Python recomputes canonical_bytes and compares; Rust returns sesslint._canonical_codec.canonical_json_bytes is not available without hashing.

GAP-writeback-r4-record-drift: Python R4 after a successful re-parse compares recomputed sha256 to stored hash (record hash drift message); Rust does not perform that comparison after the canonical seam.

GAP-writeback-r3-with-record-hash: Python R3 on a later line while earlier lines carry source_record_hash; Rust stops at canonical_json_bytes on the first hashed line and does not reach line-level R3.
GAP-writeback-api-integration: tests/repair/test_writeback.py api.repair and api.verify paths are outside repair::writeback.
